_note: Curated SEED merge map. For a source role, each of three directions (tech = deeper individual-contributor/technical; business = product/strategy; people = management) names a partner role to merge with, the emergent merged role title, and a one-line rationale. The engine synthesizes the merged role's skill vector from the residual-human skills of both roles plus AI-orchestration 'glue' skills. Illustrative only; replace with data-driven adjacency later. 'partner' must be a role id from roles.json (used to pull the partner's skill vector). If a source role is absent here, the engine falls back to vector-based nearest roles.
